captcha.title: Human Verification
captcha.description: Complete the captcha challenge so we know you're not a bot.
captcha.errorOnSignIn: Please complete the captcha challenge before signing in.
captcha.errorOnSignUp: Please complete the captcha challenge before signing up.

login.title: Sign in to your account
login.subtitle: Use a passkey, password, or your organization’s SSO.

passkey.description: Use your fingerprint, face, or device PIN.
passkey.passwordAlternative: or sign in with a password
passkey.inProgress: Finish or cancel passkey sign-in before using your password.
passkey.title: Use a saved passkey
passkey.help: Sign in with your password or SSO, then open User Profile → Passkeys & Two Factor Auth to create your first passkey.
passkey.waitingDescription: Follow the prompt from your browser or password manager.
passkey.cancelled: Passkey sign-in canceled. You can try again or use your password.
passkey.notCompleted: Passkey sign-in was canceled or timed out. Try again, or sign in with your password.
passkey.unsupported: Passkeys aren’t available in this browser. You can still sign in with your password or SSO.
passkey.insecure: Passkeys need a secure connection (HTTPS). You can still sign in with your password or SSO.

twoFactor.title: Two Factor Authentication
twoFactor.subtitle: Select two factor authentication method. You will be asked to enter a code from the selected method.
twoFactor.securityKeyInstructions: Please follow the instructions on your security key device.
twoFactor.codeFieldDescription: Enter the code from your authenticator app
twoFactor.selectDifferentMethod: Select a different two factor authentication method
twoFactor.backupCodeInstruction: Enter one of the backup codes you saved when you set up two factor authentication. Each code works only once.
twoFactor.backupCodeFieldDescription: Backup codes look like ABCDE-12345. Upper or lower case and the hyphen do not matter.
twoFactor.confirmSubtitle: Confirm it is you to finish signing in.
twoFactor.recoverySubtitle: Use a backup code, or find out how to get back in without one.
twoFactor.noBackupCodes: There is no code you can enter here, because this account has never been given a set.
twoFactor.noBackupCodesInstruction: Ask an administrator of this OneUptime instance to reset two factor authentication on your account. You will then be able to sign in with your password and set a new authenticator app up, and backup codes will be created for you at the same time.
twoFactor.lostAccessSecurityKey: Lost access to your security key?

twoFactorEnrolment.title: Set Up Two Factor Authentication
twoFactorEnrolment.subtitle: Your administrator requires two factor authentication on this account. Set it up now to finish signing in.
twoFactorEnrolment.scanInstruction: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password.
twoFactorEnrolment.codeFieldDescription: Enter the six digit code your authenticator app is showing.
twoFactorEnrolment.backToSignIn: Sign in as a different user

backupCodes.title: Save Your Backup Codes
backupCodes.subtitle: Use one of these to sign in if you ever lose access to your authenticator app or security key.
backupCodes.showOnceStrong: This is the only time these codes will be shown.
backupCodes.showOnce: Save them somewhere other than the device that generates your codes. Each code can be used once.
backupCodes.savedConfirmation: I have saved these codes somewhere safe.
backupCodes.fileHeading: OneUptime two factor authentication backup codes
backupCodes.fileInstruction: Each code can be used once. Keep this file somewhere safe and separate from the device that runs your authenticator app.
backupCodes.setUpSubtitle: One last thing before you continue.
backupCodes.none: If you lose your authenticator app or security key, an administrator will have to reset two factor authentication before you can sign in again.
backupCodes.generateFailed: No backup codes were returned. Please try again from User Profile > Two Factor Authentication.

register.title: Create your OneUptime account
register.subtitle: Join thousands of businesses that use OneUptime to help them stay online all the time.
register.notifySelfHosted: Notify me about security patches and new releases
register.checkEmailMessage: If this email address has an account waiting to be set up, we've sent it a link to finish registering. Please do not forget to check spam.
register.verifyEmailTitle: Verify your email to finish signing up
register.verifyEmailSentTo: We've sent a verification link to {{email}}.
register.verifyEmailSent: We've sent you a verification link.
register.verifyEmailInstructions: Open the link in that email to activate your account, then sign in.
register.verifyEmailResendHint: Can't find it? Check your spam folder. The link expires in 24 hours, and signing in with your email and password sends you a new one.
register.verifyEmailSpamHint: Can't find it? Check your spam or junk folder. The link expires in 24 hours.
register.verifyEmailUseDifferentEmail: Sign up with a different email

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Please enter your email and the password reset link will be sent to you.
forgotPassword.successMessage: We have emailed you the password reset link. Please do not forget to check spam.

resetPassword.title: Reset your password
resetPassword.subtitle: Please enter your new password and we will have it updated.
resetPassword.successMessage: Your password has been updated. Please log in.

sso.title: Login with SSO
sso.subtitle: Login with your SSO provider to access your account.
sso.selectProjectSubtitle: Select the project you want to login to.
sso.noConfigForEmail: No SSO configuration found for the email: {{email}}
sso.emailRequired: Email is required to perform this action

verifyEmail.successDescription: Thank you for verifying your email. You can now log in to OneUptime.
verifyEmail.linkInvalidTitle: This verification link is no longer valid
verifyEmail.requestNewLinkDescription: If your link has expired or stopped working, we can email you a new one.

resendVerificationEmail.countdown: You can request another email in {{time}}.
resendVerificationEmail.sent: We've sent a new verification link. It can take a minute or two to arrive.
resendVerificationEmail.wait: A verification email was sent recently. You can request another one when the timer runs out.
resendVerificationEmail.alreadyVerified: Your email address is already verified. You can sign in now.
resendVerificationEmail.failed: We couldn't send a new verification email. Please try again in a moment.

form.successTitle: Thank you — your response was submitted.

forbidden.title: Forbidden
forbidden.description: You do not have permission to access this page.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: Page you are looking for does not exist.

mobilePasskey.title: Sign in to OneUptime On-Call
mobilePasskey.description: Use a passkey saved for this OneUptime server.
mobilePasskey.returnDescription: After you approve, you’ll return to the mobile app.
mobilePasskey.invalid: Start sign-in from the OneUptime mobile app. This request is missing or invalid.
mobilePasskey.insecure: Passkeys require HTTPS. Return to the app and check your server address.
mobilePasskey.failed: Sign-in could not be completed. Return to the app and try again.
mobilePasskey.complete: Your passkey was verified. Return to the app to finish signing in.
mobilePasskey.setup: Create a passkey in User Profile → Passkeys & Two Factor Auth in the web dashboard.

mcpAuthorize.title: Connect an MCP client
mcpAuthorize.wantsAccess: {{clientName}} wants to access OneUptime on your behalf.
mcpAuthorize.verifiedHostHelp: This is where the client is published. Only continue if you recognise it.
mcpAuthorize.unverifiedNameHelp: The name above was chosen by the client itself and has not been verified by OneUptime.
mcpAuthorize.redirectToThisDevice: You will be sent to an app on this device ({{target}}).
mcpAuthorize.loopbackWarning: Any app running on this device could receive this sign-in. Only continue if you started connecting an MCP client yourself, just now.
mcpAuthorize.projectHelp: The client will work in this project only.

projectRefusal.plan: {{name}} - plan does not include MCP clients
projectRefusal.sso: {{name}} - sign in with single sign-on first

mcpAuthorize.noProjects: You do not belong to a project yet. Create or join one, then connect your MCP client again.
mcpAuthorize.noEligibleProjects: None of your projects can be connected right now. The reason is shown next to each project.
mcpAuthorize.accessWriteDescription: View data and make changes: acknowledge and resolve incidents and alerts, add notes, and create, update or delete resources.
mcpAuthorize.accessReadDescription: View incidents, alerts, monitors, status pages and telemetry. Cannot change anything.
mcpAuthorize.permissionsNote: The client acts as you and can never do more than your own permissions in this project allow. You can disconnect it at any time in Project Settings > MCP Server.
mcpAuthorize.redirectingHelp: You can close this window once your MCP client says it is connected.
mcpAuthorize.errorTitle: This MCP client cannot be connected
mcpAuthorize.errorHelp: Go back to your MCP client and try connecting again.

errors.missing_request: This page was opened without an authorization request, or the request has expired.
errors.oauth_disabled: Signing in to the MCP server is turned off on this OneUptime instance. Use an API key instead.
errors.missing_client_id: The MCP client did not say who it is.
errors.unknown_client: OneUptime does not recognise this MCP client. Its registration may have expired: remove the server from your MCP client and add it again.
errors.client_metadata_unavailable: OneUptime could not reach the MCP client's website to check who it is. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.client_metadata_invalid: The MCP client's description of itself is not valid.
errors.missing_redirect_uri: The MCP client did not say where to send you after you authorize.
errors.redirect_uri_mismatch: The MCP client asked to send you somewhere it has not registered. The request was stopped to keep your account safe.
errors.request_too_large: The MCP client's request is too large.
errors.server_error: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.framed: For your security, this page cannot be used inside another page. Open it in its own browser tab or window.
